description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training set is divided among 13 data sources (slices). The largest slice is labeled NQ and is colored dark blue at about 31.3%. Other slices include FEVER (light blue/teal, ~16.1%), SNLI (orange, ~15.4%), VITAMINC (pale cyan, ~13.0%), MULTINLI (pink/red, ~11.3%), ANLI (green, ~4.6%), FACTCC (yellow, ~2.6%), ENTFA (light orange, ~1.8%), XSUMHUL (very light blue, ~1.6%), SCITAIL (light green, ~1.2%), and three very small slices: PUBHEALTH (grayish, ~0.5%), MULTIFC (grayish, ~0.5%), and SCIFACT (very thin slice, ~0.1%). The chart uses external callout labels with percentages (not printed inside the slices), and there is no separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice order appears arranged around the circle rather than strictly sorted by size.
